title: Robot and Mushroom in Enchanted Forest
description: A large golden robot with a glowing green mushroom cap sits in a mystical forest, gently holding a human hand emerging from the right. Three young girls in yellow dresses dance along a colorful musical path in the foreground while a ghostly figure holds a lit candle atop a hill surrounded by wooden dolls.
prompt: A giant friendly golden robot wearing a large glowing green mushroom cap with white spots sits in an enchanted glowing forest. A ghostly translucent figure stands on a rocky hill holding a tall lit candle with swirling colorful smoke. Three little girls in bright yellow dresses hold hands and dance along a winding path made of colorful musical notes. A human hand with a white lace cuff reaches from the right to touch the robot's hand. Light rays shine from above, bioluminescent plants, floating orbs, and scattered papers on the ground.
